items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: I had two...three entertainers--Rucker, and I had...oh, I can't think of...Carolyn Sn...Carolyn Williams.

ctx.x: That was where Ory played, right?

Yeah, and I had...uh, Black and Tan played there, and I had two...three entertainers--Rucker, and I had...oh, I can't think of...Carolyn Sn...Carolyn Williams. She was great at that time, you know --floor singer. And I had a couple of other singers.
And Black and Tan was led by Paul Howard, wasn't it?
